meta.tldr: Omadesign QA day: two Transform panel bugs filed with exact repros for rotated objects and sub-pixel strokes, plus two X replies with product feedback

shipped.title: Omadesign · Transform panel bugs filed
shipped.summary: Hands-on testing turned up two related resize bugs in Omadesign's Transform panel, each filed publicly with step-by-step repros and a pointer to the likely fix.
bullets: Rotated objects: on shapes turned ±90° or 270°, typing a new width changes the height instead; the fix reads and writes the object's own size through its transform, like Illustrator and Figma
Sub-pixel strokes: a 0.25 stroke outlined to a path is clamped to a 1px minimum when resized, losing its true thickness
Cross-linked repro: changing the width of a rotated 0.25 line collapsed it to a 1×1px square, tying both issues to the same minimum-size clamp

landed.title: X · 2 posts, 35 public impressions
landed.summary: Two replies with product feedback: a Grok Bot desktop bug report on Omarchy (screenshots can't be sent in messages), and a wish list for Vicinae covering UI polish, search, and deeper system menu integration.
